messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "injected under the skin once per week at any time of the day with or without food"
set: ["injected under the skin once per week at any time of the day with or without food", "administer once weekly on the same day each week at any time of the day with or without meals", "can be given with or without meals at any time of the day", "under the skin", "once per day at same time of day", "take with food at the same time each day", "take once a day in the morning, with or without food", "give once weekly at any time of day, with or without meals", "injection under the skin", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "with or without food", "thickening or hollowing of the skin where you injected the medicine", "purple spots under the skin", "taken once daily with or without food", "take once daily with or without food", "take with or without food"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
